item.title: Dokoka de Eros wa Gekidoshita. Shojo no Kuni no Alice
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Maketenai to Iihare.
  • 発売日: 2011-08-16
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: どこかでエロスは激怒した。処女の国のアリス
  • 英語名: Dokoka de Eros wa Gekidoshita. Shojo no Kuni no Alice

别名

  • Somewhere Eros Raged. Alice of the Virgin Land

あらすじ

Alice had the gift to see things normal people could not.

Her happy life was sometimes interrupted by violence.

One day the environment around her changed drastically… in sense only.

To the casual eye nothing was different… and yet everything was wrong.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Maketenai to Iihare.
  • 発売日: 2011-08-16
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: どこかでエロスは激怒した。処女の国のアリス
  • 英語名: Dokoka de Eros wa Gekidoshita. Shojo no Kuni no Alice

あらすじ

Alice had the gift to see things normal people could not.

Her happy life was sometimes interrupted by violence.

One day the environment around her changed drastically… in sense only.

To the casual eye nothing was different… and yet everything was wrong.

What could this feeling be? Had it always been this way?
